title: 4521-ESP-ANC-58-61-PS001
summary:
- Contract allows alternate billing cycles.
- Project is a concentrated solar power facility.
- Vendor must fabricate all pipe spools for HTF piping.
- All pipe supports are pre-furnished by Abener Teyma.
- Vendor must comply with ASME B 31.3 standards.
- Contract allows alternate billing cycles other than thirty days.
- Confidential information must not be reproduced without permission.
- Socketweld joints cannot be radiographed; visual inspection is required.
- Vendor responsible for cleaning pipe spools and maintaining cleanliness during fabrication.
- Fabricated pieces must be clearly marked with unique piece numbers.
- Vendor must provide engineering office with drawing prints of fabricated pipe spools.
- Root pass welds must use TIG welding process.
summary_points: Project is a concentrated solar power facility.
Vendor must fabricate all pipe spools for HTF piping.
All pipe supports are pre-furnished by Abener Teyma.
Vendor must comply with ASME B 31.3 standards.
Contract allows alternate billing cycles other than thirty days.
Confidential information must not be reproduced without permission.
Socketweld joints cannot be radiographed; visual inspection is required.
Vendor responsible for cleaning pipe spools and maintaining cleanliness during fabrication.
Fabricated pieces must be clearly marked with unique piece numbers.
Vendor must provide engineering office with drawing prints of fabricated pipe spools.
Root pass welds must use TIG welding process.
Pipe spools must adhere to specific cleaning standards before shipment.
Protection of flanged ends with proper covers and caps.
Vendor responsibilities for Victaulic couplings in carbon steel piping systems.
Vendor must provide carbon steel flanges at stub-end connections in stainless steel piping systems.
Fabrication tolerances include end preparation, linear dimensions, angular tolerances, and exceptions.
